# Fuse

> Fuse is a .NET tool that keeps a repository's C# solution compiled in memory with Roslyn and gives AI coding agents the compiler errors their edits introduced, the tests those edits can break, and compact build output. It runs through agent hooks and an MCP server, locally, with no telemetry.

Fuse needs the .NET 10 SDK. Install it with `dotnet tool install -g Fuse`, then run `fuse init` in a repository. `fuse init` registers Fuse's hooks with each agent harness the repository uses: Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode and VS Code agent mode (through the MCP server). After each edit the agent gets only the errors that edit introduced, compared with HEAD, the commit you have checked out. When the agent runs `dotnet test`, only the affected tests run and only failures are printed. Fuse is open source under the Apache-2.0 license.

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/README.md): where each topic is documented
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/getting-started.md): install Fuse and set it up in a repository
- [Commands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/commands.md): every fuse command, its arguments and its exit codes
- [Harnesses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/harnesses.md): how fuse init sets up each supported harness
- [How it works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/how-it-works.md): how Fuse checks an edit, selects tests and runs them
- [Results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/results.md): the measured speed and accuracy
- [Evals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/evals.md): how the evals work and how to run them
- [Limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/limits.md): what Fuse cannot check
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): messages, log locations and how to stop the engine
